summary: Phase 2 extends Phase 1 with a working dual-layer piano engine, per-layer effect chains, and Master Level on one AudioContext — all four gates pass (38/38 tests) with rendered-audio assertions. The decorative boundary for Organ/Synth/Program is preserved. The main gap is sample provenance: Grand/Upright/Electric are programmatically synthesized OfflineAudioContext buffers (sampleSources: 0), honestly declared but not bundled recorded sample sets as the piano spec requires. Effects processing, bypass, and layer routing are tested; global-mode and exhaustive per-type variant coverage are partial.

criteria.label: Surface fidelity retention
evidence: Stage2 visual audit confirms 73-key keybed, six-section layout, ~150 decorative controls, and Program/Synth OLED placement unchanged from Phase 1.
Sealed verification passed with 20/20 feature IDs including regression.phase1 mapped to inherited Phase 1 test files.
Capture harness reports zero console errors at desktop and narrow profiles.

criteria.label: Piano/effect hardware state
evidence: Piano type LEDs, layer enable/level/octave, and performance toggles wired via control-bindings to audio state.
Effects knobs and bypass toggles update focused piano layer parameters; Master Level scales master gain.
Status bar shows load state and active voice count.

criteria.label: Distinct Piano instruments
evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares sampleSources: 0; Grand/Upright/Electric are OfflineAudioContext-generated buffers, not bundled recordings.
Rendered-audio tests assert six types produce measurably distinct signals (signalsDiffer), and strategy text is truthful about synthesis.
Meets audibly-distinct/offline honesty but fails the recorded-sample-set requirement that drives Phase 2 piano library scoring.

criteria.label: Two-layer Piano behavior
evidence: Engine tests cover layer A/B enable, focus, level fader binding, and per-layer voice ownership.
SUSTPED honored per layer; octave shift changes playback rate/root selection in tests.

criteria.label: Detailed Piano controls
evidence: Tests assert KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, and String Res alter rendered RMS or envelope timing.
Master Level changes master output gain through the limiter path.

criteria.label: Input and fallback reliability
evidence: Inherited Phase 1 input tests remain green: pointer, keyboard repeat suppression, MIDI mock port with CC64 sustain.
Fallback voice test enters labeled synth fallback when sample load is forced to fail.

criteria.label: Shared graph and gain staging
evidence: effects.graph tests assert one AudioContext, ordered Mod1→Reverb chain, shared Rotary, master gain/limiter, and voice cleanup to zero.
Per-layer buses feed independent effect chains before mix bus.

criteria.label: Audible effect coverage
evidence: effects.processing tests prove bypass/wet-dry and measurable signal change for representative units.
Not every named type variant (e.g. all six Mod1 types) has individual rendered-audio assertions.

criteria.label: Routing and control
evidence: Focus follows layer focus; group bypass and all-effects bypass tested.
Global mode toggles for Delay/Compressor/Reverb referenced but simplified relative to full spec panel inventory.

criteria.label: Audible/visible feedback
evidence: Rendered-audio tests use AnalyserNode/offline RMS utilities; effect on produces higher RMS than bypass.
Type and layer changes produce non-identical signals.

criteria.label: Failure and stress behavior
evidence: Forced sample failure enters labeled fallback without reporting primary library ready.
Polyphony stealing and all-notes-off cleanup tests pass after rapid note bursts.

criteria.label: Audio architecture
evidence: Clear separation: samples.ts, effects-chain.ts, engine.ts orchestrator, control-bindings.ts.
IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN includes signal graph diagram and hard-gate checklist.

criteria.label: Real-boundary tests
evidence: node-web-audio-api enables deterministic rendered-audio tests in Vitest/jsdom.
Feature matrix maps all Phase 2 IDs including regression.phase1 to real test files.

criteria.label: Performance and maintainability
evidence: Test suite ~25s dominated by six-type sample synthesis at engine init.
234 KB production bundle; architecture readable but sample generation at load adds startup cost.

issues.description: Grand/Upright/Electric are synthesized buffers, not bundled recorded sample sets (sampleSources: 0); truthful declaration limits rubric score on instrumentBreadth.
Effect type enumeration and global routing controls are partially implemented relative to the full effects spec.
